parameter_description: Send a Program Change on MIDI channel 7 to recall a Scene by its number
notes: Program Change 1-128 on MIDI channel 7 recalls Scene 1-128 (combine with Scene Bank Select MSB for Scene numbers above 128, up to 1000). Requires SETUP > MIDI REMOTE CONTROL > SCENE CHANGE enabled. Whether this is active can depend on the console's Show Control configuration - verify against your firmware

parameter_description: Send a Program Change on MIDI channel 8 to recall a Scene, Snip, Clip, Preset, or Audio Clip by its Library tag
notes: Program Change 1-128 on MIDI channel 8 recalls Library item tag #1-128 (combine with Scene Tag Bank Select MSB for tags above #128, up to #16384). Requires SETUP > MIDI REMOTE CONTROL > SHOW CONTROL enabled. Tags are a more robust alternative to raw Scene numbers, since they don't depend on Scene ordering
